description: A copy structure artifact is valid when every content slot has a unique id and screen reference, all placeholders are typed with examples, state coverage entries are complete, primary slots have character limits, and i18n interpolation keys match declared placeholders.

rules.description: copy-structure-spec.json must exist with a content_slots array. Copy without a spec cannot be audited for completeness or i18n correctness.
Every content slot must declare a screen (string). Without a screen reference, slots cannot be mapped to their UI context.
All slot ids must be unique across the spec. Duplicate ids create ambiguous copy lookup and override unexpected content.
Every slot must declare priority as primary, secondary, or tertiary. Priority drives character limit enforcement and rendering hierarchy.
Every placeholder must be an object with key, type, and example. Bare string placeholders cannot be type-checked or localized correctly.
Every stateCoverage entry must have a valid state (loading, success, empty, error) and either content (string) or inherit (boolean). States without content produce blank UI.
All primary slots must declare charLimit as a positive number. Primary content without a character budget causes layout overflow in constrained containers.
All {{key}} and {key} interpolation patterns in content strings must have a matching placeholder entry in the same slot. Undeclared keys cause runtime i18n errors.
Slots declaring experimentVariant must provide a non-empty variantId. Slots that are not part of an experiment must set experimentVariant=null explicitly.
The spec must declare feature_id or id for cross-compiler reference tracking and artifact lineage.
